title: Water, Contracts & Lawsuit Legal Strategy
summary:
*   The city held a special closed-door meeting to receive legal advice on several important issues.
*   **Aquifer Protection**: Legal counsel was sought regarding an audit of the Barton Springs Edwards Aquifer Conservation District, a vital environmental concern.
*   **City Contracts & Bidding**: Discussions addressed legal compliance for local preference in city contracts and competitive bidding processes.
*   **Land Use Regulations**: Legal matters concerning properties located near the 504.9 contour line were examined, likely related to development or environmental zones.
*   **Xerox Class Action**: Received legal advice regarding a specific class-action lawsuit, R&D Business Systems v. Xerox Corporation.
